description: Create a List in a Folder from a List template, reproducing the template's statuses, fields and (optionally) tasks. Returns the created List. Use to spin up a standardized List layout.

folder_id.description: ID of the Folder to create the List in.

options.description: Optional template import options, e.g. { return_immediately: true, content: {...} }.

template_id.description: ID of the List template to instantiate.

name: create_list_from_template_in_folder
